name: session-journal
description: Record Codex and Claude Code sessions to an Obsidian vault (or a subfolder of an existing one): one daily journal note (Journal/<date>.md) with a chronological summary block per MEANINGFUL session (throwaway sessions skipped, no verbatim transcript, no auto-generated wiki). The bulky raw event log lives OUTSIDE the vault (under $XDG_STATE_HOME/session-journal) with retention. Every note is tagged #ai-generated to stay distinct from hand-authored notes. Portable name-based vault resolution (with an explicit-pin guard against duplicate same-named vaults) for multi-machine setups synced via Obsidian Sync.

interface.shortDescription: Record agent sessions into an Obsidian vault.
interface.longDescription: Capture Claude Code and Codex prompts, tool activity, and final results through lifecycle hooks; roll meaningful sessions up into one daily journal note (Journal/<date>.md, throwaway sessions skipped) while the append-only raw log stays outside the vault with retention. No verbatim transcript, no auto-generated wiki; Obsidian wikilinks for graph navigation.
defaultPrompt: Show where session-journal writes Obsidian notes.
